clips.title: The story
paras: Frostmane Hold is an Alliance recon mission assigned by Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos. Having tracked the hostile Frostmane trolls to their heavily guarded cavern stronghold near Iceflow Lake, Senir enlists adventurous scouts to brave the interior, eliminate their headhunters, and supply vital intel for his scouting reports.

Stationed in Kharanos, mountaineer and scout Senir Whitebeard was tasked with monitoring the encroaching Frostmane troll threat across Dun Morogh. While he successfully traced the aggressive tribes back to their primary cavern dwelling southwest of Brewnall Village, the sheer volume of armed trolls gave him pause. Reluctant to step foot inside alone and falling severely behind on his official reports, Senir hires passing adventurers to venture into the icy recesses on his behalf.

The stronghold sits carved into the western peaks overlooking Iceflow Lake, a freezing redoubt packed with hostile ice trolls. To fulfill Senir's mission, scouts must fight their way deep through the subterranean tunnels, cull the fierce Frostmane Headhunters stationed along the ledges, and map the interior layout. Surviving the delve provides the critical intelligence Senir requires to finalize his findings for Ironforge's military commanders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm behind on my report, and could use your help, friend. I just managed to find where the trolls are holed up, but I saw so many trolls, I was afraid to go in.
Here's what I need... Go down to the cave, poke around inside, kill a few of the trolls, then come back here.

Take the road north out of Kharanos, when you get to the bridge, follow the frozen river west until you reach Iceflow Lake. You'll find Brewnall Village on the west bank. The Hold is southwest of the village.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You can't find it? My directions were very clear! We don't have much time, you've got to hurry! Don't come back until you've found the cave.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, friend! I didn't think you'd have much trouble finding the place, my directions are excellent, you know...
Let me just finish up my report then.
There! Well, haha, now this certainly is funny... I don't suppose, friend, that you would mind doing one last favor for me?
